# Donkey Ideas — Full Reference

> Donkey Ideas is a New York–based, one-person venture studio that turns early-stage, "dumb-sounding" ideas into real digital businesses, and offers fractional CFO services to startups and small businesses across the US. Every idea is validated with market research and a real financial model — backed by 20 years of controller and CFO experience — then designed, built, and launched with an AI-native process.

## Company facts
- Type: Venture studio (creates and operates its own startups) + fractional CFO practice
- Location: New York, NY; works remotely with companies across the United States
- Founder background: 20 years as a controller and CFO across SaaS, financial services, and public companies
- Portfolio: 12 ventures across consumer apps, B2B SaaS, fintech, media, and gaming
- Contact: info@donkeyideas.com — Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/bTGoJDjxDWSHijKZ7

## Fractional CFO services
Donkey Ideas provides remote, part-time (fractional) CFO leadership for startups and small businesses:
- Financial modeling and forecasting: unit economics, three-statement models, scenario planning you can defend in a board meeting
- Budgeting, cash flow, and runway: know how much cash you have, how fast it moves, and when decisions are due
- Fundraising preparation: investor-ready projections, data-room assembly, pitch financials that survive diligence
- Investor reporting and board support: the monthly update investors actually read
- Monthly close oversight, KPIs, and dashboards: run the business on numbers instead of vibes
- Systems and process: accounting stack setup, dashboards, and financial hygiene that scales
Page: https://www.donkeyideas.com/fractional-cfo

### Fractional CFO — frequently asked questions
Q: What is a fractional CFO?
A: A senior finance executive who works with your company part-time — typically a set number of days per month — providing CFO-level leadership (financial modeling, forecasting, cash-flow management, fundraising support) at a fraction of the cost of a full-time hire.

Q: Do fractional CFOs work remotely?
A: Yes — it's now the standard model. Modeling, forecasting, close review, and board reporting all run on cloud accounting and shared dashboards. Donkey Ideas works fully remotely with companies across the US from a New York base.

Q: When should a startup hire a fractional CFO?
A: Common triggers: preparing to raise, revenue passing roughly $500K–$1M, cash decisions getting consequential, investors asking for reporting you can't produce, or a bookkeeper handling transactions while nobody owns the forward-looking numbers.

Q: What's the difference between a fractional CFO, a controller, and a bookkeeper?
A: A bookkeeper records transactions; a controller makes sure the books close accurately; a CFO looks forward — scenarios, runway, budgets, fundraises. Donkey Ideas has 20 years across all three layers.

Q: How much does a fractional CFO cost?
A: A monthly retainer scoped to fixed deliverables and cadence — a small fraction of a full-time CFO's salary and equity. The first diagnostic call is free.

## The venture studio
Donkey Ideas validates every idea the same way — market and competitor research, a real financial model with unit economics, and a small, fast prototype to test demand — before serious time or money is committed. Winners get doubled down on; experiments get honest reviews.
